items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: so Howard Davis played the clarinet, and George Lewis

ctx.x: That's Bat Mosley. John Mosley, that's his right name, but we call him Bat Mosley. And I had Howard Davis, I think he was to play, but something had happened that he couldn't, so Howard Davis played the clarinet, and George Lewis. No saxophone?
